decision.canonical_contract: SearchIntent v1 remains provider-neutral and unchanged.
decision.comparison_unit: The same 60 canonical intent identities and hidden targets are used across providers; literal wire text may differ only through a digest-bound provider projector required by a published transport limit.
decision.semantic_lane_fairness: The 24 semantic intents use the same compact query text across compared providers wherever transport limits permit; no domain filter is silently added to one provider.
decision.precise_lane_fairness: The 36 precise intents may use provider-native site/date fields because filter capability is itself part of the measured product; the canonical intent and target remain identical.
next_scope_requirements: Implement a provider wire request object that references canonical intent_id and digest.
Implement Baidu <=72 weighted-unit projection with no loss of owner, period, claim direction or source-family atoms.
Move domains and dates into typed structured fields instead of wasting query text.
Freeze Tencent, Baidu, Alibaba-MCP and Firecrawl capability profiles without provider-specific branches in core SearchIntent.
Prove deterministic projection, no cross-case contamination, no target leakage, semantic-lane query parity and separate 36/24 ceilings.
Do not call a provider, reuse an exposed credential, fetch a document, tune ranking or promote Evidence.

stop_rules: No provider call before the wire projection proof and a fresh provider-specific admission.
Do not execute all 60 intents as one automatic run.
Do not compare synthesized answers with raw locator results under useful_at_10.
Do not claim Tencent or Baidu live quality from documentation-only qualification.
Do not request an international paid API while an eligible domestic comparator has not yet been tested, unless the user changes the procurement constraint.
known_boundary: This decision qualifies product shapes and exposes a Baidu input incompatibility. It does not prove live recall, date accuracy, source diversity, cost, latency, credential validity, SourceHunter integration, Agentic Research or release readiness.
